alvo._comentario: Configuracao do ALVO. Trocar de alvo = trocar este arquivo e o PDB em data/. Nada do site depende de qual proteina e.
alvo.nome_longo: Cruzain (cruzipain), the major cysteine protease of Trypanosoma cruzi
alvo.doenca_nota: Over 10,000 deaths a year in the Americas. Current therapy has poor efficacy in the chronic phase and serious side effects.
alvo.recorde_fonte: A published campaign docked nearly 4 million lead-like and fragment-like compounds against cruzain, which led to reversible carbamoyl imidazole inhibitors (PubMed 31765144).
alvo.estado_nota: Kept only so the laboratory has a real structure to replay. This protein was worked on before this launch and is not this project's record.

triagem._comentario: Zerado no relancamento. Volta a encher quando a primeira triagem rodar sob este projeto.

validacao._comentario: O enriquecimento e a reproducao de pose do alvo anterior sairam junto com o projeto anterior. O controle positivo de POSE fica: ele valida a pipeline, nao o alvo.

roadmap.base: ran on a local CPU, nothing rented

roadmap.nome: Fair decoys, and a second target evaluated
roadmap.base: Measured: one validation round is about 642 dockings (measured inhibitors plus property-matched decoys). This is the cost of putting all seven queued targets through the gate, whether they pass or fail.

Measured on the rented pod: 414 molecules per hour on 56 cores at $0.18/hour, which is $0.000435 per molecule. AutoDock Vina is CPU only; moving the docking to the GPU we already rent should cut this sharply, but that is not measured yet and is not assumed here.

roadmap.nome: Beat the largest published screen on this target
roadmap.base: Same measured rate, four million molecules — the size of the largest published screen against this target.
made-to-order synthesis, roughly three weeks. No supplier has quoted us yet — this is an order of magnitude, not a price.

roadmap.nome: Enzyme assay in a real laboratory
roadmap.base: does the molecule actually block the protein? Needs a laboratory to quote it; a conversation, not a web search.

roadmap.nome: Cell assay — parasite killed, human cells spared
roadmap.base: the last rung this project can reach on its own

roadmap_total.nota: Everything from an empty screen to a result on a real laboratory bench. The computing really is the cheap part: at the rate measured on the rented card, four million molecules cost $1,739. It is the glassware that costs.

compute.nota: Nothing has been rented under this launch yet. Every hour paid for will be published here with its date and price.
